integrity: The theorem follows from an explicit proof and independently executed finite regression checks. Publication novelty is assessed against named literature with material-access risk documented; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime p and extraspecial exponent-p groups only; n>=2.

The complete parameter equations are implicit matrix identities; closed operator counts are supplied for alpha=0 and alpha=-1, and for the balanced-rank sector of other alpha, not the total number in all other fibers.
No automorphism-orbit classification is claimed; finite verification does not prove the general theorem.
title: Symplectic parametrization and central-fiber counts for group Rota–Baxter operators
